title: Pick a coworking desk
ask: I'm giving up the home office and want a desk in a coworking space. I've noted three places in sources/options.md. Tell me which one in a short brief.
background: I need a desk three days a week and somewhere to take calls.
I cycle in, so somewhere to lock the bike matters more than parking.
Anything over $450 a month is more than the home office costs me now.

constraints.text: don't put any dollar figure over $450 in the brief, and do show prices in dollars
put your pick under a heading called "Recommendation"
compare the options in a table with the columns Space, Monthly price, Phone booths
none of the sales words "best-in-class", "game-changer" or "no-brainer"
work only from the snapshot, no web lookups
name the file you worked from, sources/options.md

start.sources/options.md:
